question: How full is each warehouse relative to its capacity?

after_sql: SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(quantity_on_hand) AS total_stock, SUM(quantity_on_hand) * 1.0 / SUM(capacity_units) AS utilization FROM inventory JOIN warehouses ON warehouses.warehouse_id = inventory.warehouse_id GROUP BY warehouse_id ORDER BY utilization DESC

question: Show warehouse utilisation as a percentage of capacity.
before_sql: SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(quantity_on_hand) AS total_stock, SUM(quantity_on_hand) / SUM(capacity_units) AS utilisation_pct FROM inventory JOIN warehouses ON inventory.warehouse_id = warehouses.warehouse_id GROUP BY warehouse_id ORDER BY utilisation_pct DESC
after_sql: SELECT w.warehouse_id, SUM(i.quantity_on_hand) AS total_stock, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(i.quantity_on_hand) / SUM(w.capacity_units), 2) AS utilisation_pct FROM inventory i JOIN warehouses w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id GROUP BY w.warehouse_id ORDER BY utilisation_pct DESC
